'''LYNX Aegis Injector''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Rhodes Island and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|The medics' preferred equipment. 
The LYNX Aegis Injector delivers sealants into cracks to help repair broken shields. It can also be used during emergencies for sealing wounds.}}
